items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Joe Morris did the Chop-Chop, if you remember, on the flip side of Hamp's Boogie Woogie.

ctx.x: Well, Milton Buckner was one of the main arrangers in the band. He did most of it. Al Hayes did a couple of tunes in the band. Joe Morris did the Chop-Chop, if you remember, on the flip side of Hamp's Boogie Woogie.
We had other arrangers to come in to do vocal (inaudible).
